fusions.name: Sodden Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps a soaked cloth at an enemy up to 3 tiles away. It deals 6 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and the target moves 25% slower for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Damp Shroud
fusions.desc: Throws a soaked sheet over the first enemy it meets. It deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Damped] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Compress
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Wicking Weave
fusions.desc: When you regain health, you also regain 2 mana a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
